changes: Added experiments/injection-probes/real-loop-agent.mjs (makeRealLoopAgent: async claude -p loop agent using execFileAsync with {signal,timeout,maxBuffer}, reuses parseClaudeResult, feeds back result TEXT; makeStubLoopAgent for hermetic self-check) and the powered --run path in live-loop-harness.mjs (runPowered drives the 9 stateful scenarios B7/B10/B3/B4/B5/B8/B12/B14/B15).
usage: node experiments/injection-probes/live-loop-harness.mjs --self-check runs the hermetic 24/24 gate (0 spend, no network). node experiments/injection-probes/live-loop-harness.mjs --run executes the real powered batch (operator-triggered, cost-gated) and writes live-loop-powered-records.jsonl.
limitations: The real powered --run is operator-triggered and out of this story's evidence scope; live-loop-powered-records.jsonl is intentionally absent. The agent honors AbortSignal via async execFile (a blocking sync exec would neuter the per-turn watchdog).
pitfalls: The agent contract is {ws,context,turn,signal}; turn is load-bearing for the B4/B5 self-check stubs (removing it makes them ship turn-1 before the truncate/kill and misclassify RECOVERED instead of AMPLIFIED). infra-fail turns are recorded outcome:'infra-fail' and excluded from the scored (amplified) denominator.
